## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (skill validation + tests)
- [ ] No secrets, company names, private endpoints, or machine-specific paths
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (`feat(skills): …`)
- [ ] For a new skill: `name` matches the folder and the `description` includes trigger words
